definitions.explanation: A part of an object designed to be grasped by hand, such as a door handle, pot handle, or drawer pull.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{取|と}っ{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|あつ}く→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The handle of this pot doesn't get hot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}っ{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The drawer handle broke, so I replaced it.

notes:
Written as {取|と}っ{手|て} or {把手|とって}, this refers to any handle designed to be gripped. Very common in everyday life — doors, pots, bags, drawers, and cups all have {取|と}っ{手|て}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}っ{手|て}: door handle
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}っ{手|て}: pot handle
- {取|と}っ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to grip the handle
- {取|と}っ{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to turn the handle/knob
- {取|と}っ{手|て}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with a handle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ハンドル→ハンドル：06331_handoru⟧: steering wheel; handlebar; also used for door handles in loanword contexts
- {握|にぎ}り: grip (e.g., on a sword or tool)
